name: qa-overstrict-gate
description: QA agent reviews a correct code patch in an environment where repo-wide `vitest --run` fails due to pre-existing dependency issues unrelated to the patch. Tests whether QA can distinguish environment-level test failures from patch-level correctness. A good QA agent recognizes that global vitest failures caused by missing deps are not caused by the patch and gives PASS. A bad QA agent (OVER-STRICT_GATE pattern) marks FAIL solely because vitest --run returned non-zero.
